rationale_md: Japan enters this Group F clash as slight favorites, backed by a 110-point Elo rating advantage that reflects their stronger recent international form and technical quality. The narrow margin between both sides' win probabilities—separated by just two percentage points—indicates this match could easily swing either direction or end level.
